edition: 2018/2020 national edition (Interactive Student Edition and Teacher Edition, 2 volumes each)

summary: McGraw Hill's grade 6 course in the Reveal Math middle-school series, in 10 modules and 59 lessons. It covers ratios, rates, and percents; fraction division and multi-digit computation; integers, rational numbers, and the coordinate plane; expressions and one-step equations and inequalities; two-variable relationships; area, surface area, and volume; and statistics.

toc.label: Module 1
toc.title: Ratios and Rates
toc.covers: Ratio language, equivalent ratios in tables and graphs, comparing ratios, customary unit conversion, and unit rates.

children.title: Understand Ratios
children.covers: Writing ratios that compare part to part or part to whole.

children.title: Tables of Equivalent Ratios
children.covers: Building ratio tables to generate equivalent ratios and find missing values.

children.title: Graphs of Equivalent Ratios
children.covers: Plotting equivalent ratio pairs on the coordinate plane and reading the resulting graph.

children.title: Compare Ratio Relationships
children.covers: Comparing two ratio relationships with tables, graphs, and unit values.

children.title: Solve Ratio Problems
children.covers: Solving real-world ratio problems with tape diagrams, double number lines, and ratio tables.

children.title: Convert Customary Measurement Units
children.covers: Using ratio reasoning to convert customary units of length, weight, and capacity.

children.title: Understand Rates and Unit Rates
children.covers: Defining rates and finding unit rates, including unit prices.

children.title: Solve Rate Problems
children.covers: Solving unit-price, constant-speed, and other rate problems.

toc.label: Module 2
toc.title: Fractions, Decimals, and Percents
toc.covers: How fractions, decimals, and percents relate, applied to finding a percent of a number and finding the whole.

children.title: Understand Percents
children.covers: Modeling percents as rates per 100 with 10 x 10 grids and bar diagrams.

children.title: Percents Greater Than 100% and Less Than 1%
children.covers: Modeling percents above 100% and below 1% on 10 x 10 grids.

children.title: Relate Fractions, Decimals, and Percents
children.covers: Converting among fractions, decimals, and percents.

children.title: Find the Percent of a Number
children.covers: Finding a percent of a quantity with bar diagrams, equivalent ratios, double number lines, and ratio tables.

children.title: Estimate the Percent of a Number
children.covers: Estimating a percent of a number with benchmark percents and compatible numbers.

children.title: Find the Whole
children.covers: Finding the whole when the part and the percent are known.

toc.label: Module 3
toc.title: Compute with Multi-Digit Numbers and Fractions
toc.covers: Fluent long division and decimal computation, and dividing fractions and mixed numbers.

children.title: Divide Multi-Digit Whole Numbers
children.covers: Dividing multi-digit whole numbers with the standard long-division algorithm.

children.title: Compute With Multi-Digit Decimals
children.covers: Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing multi-digit decimals with standard algorithms.

children.title: Divide Whole Numbers by Fractions
children.covers: Dividing whole numbers by fractions with models and reciprocals.

children.title: Divide Fractions by Fractions
children.covers: Dividing a fraction by a fraction with models and by multiplying by the reciprocal, and interpreting the quotient.

children.title: Divide with Whole and Mixed Numbers
children.covers: Dividing with mixed numbers by rewriting them as fractions, in word problems.

toc.label: Module 4
toc.title: Integers, Rational Numbers, and the Coordinate Plane
toc.covers: Negative numbers on the number line, opposites, absolute value, ordering rational numbers, and graphing in all four quadrants.

children.title: Represent Integers
children.covers: Using positive and negative integers for real-world quantities and placing them on a number line.

children.title: Opposites and Absolute Value
children.covers: Finding opposites and absolute value as distance from zero.

children.title: Compare and Order Integers
children.covers: Comparing and ordering integers with a number line and inequality symbols.

children.title: Rational Numbers
children.covers: Locating, comparing, and ordering positive and negative fractions and decimals.

children.title: The Coordinate Plane
children.covers: Graphing ordered pairs in all four quadrants.

children.title: Graph Reflections of Points
children.covers: Reflecting points across the axes and relating sign changes in coordinates to the reflection.

children.title: Absolute Value and Distance
children.covers: Using absolute value to find the distance between points that share a coordinate.

toc.label: Module 5
toc.title: Numerical and Algebraic Expressions
toc.covers: Exponents, order of operations, writing and evaluating algebraic expressions, GCF and LCM, and equivalent expressions.

children.title: Powers and Exponents
children.covers: Writing and evaluating whole-number exponents.

children.title: Numerical Expressions
children.covers: Evaluating numerical expressions with exponents using the order of operations.

children.title: Write Algebraic Expressions
children.covers: Translating verbal phrases into algebraic expressions with variables.

children.title: Evaluate Algebraic Expressions
children.covers: Substituting values for variables to evaluate expressions and formulas.

children.title: Factors and Multiples
children.covers: Finding the greatest common factor and least common multiple of whole numbers.

children.title: Use the Distributive Property
children.covers: Rewriting expressions with the Distributive Property, including factoring out a common factor.

children.title: Equivalent Algebraic Expressions
children.covers: Combining like terms and using properties to identify equivalent expressions.

toc.label: Module 6
toc.title: Equations and Inequalities
toc.covers: Solving one-step equations by substitution and inverse operations, and writing and graphing simple inequalities.

children.title: Use Substitution to Solve One-Step Equations
children.covers: Testing values by substitution to find which make an equation true.

children.title: One-Step Addition Equations
children.covers: Solving equations of the form x + p = q with bar models and subtraction.

children.title: One-Step Subtraction Equations
children.covers: Solving equations of the form x - p = q with addition.

children.title: One-Step Multiplication Equations
children.covers: Solving equations of the form px = q, including fraction and decimal coefficients.

children.title: One-Step Division Equations
children.covers: Solving equations of the form x / p = q with multiplication.

children.title: Inequalities
children.covers: Writing inequalities, testing solutions, and graphing solution sets on a number line.

toc.label: Module 7
toc.title: Relationships Between Two Variables
toc.covers: Independent and dependent variables shown in tables, equations, and graphs.

children.title: Relationships Between Two Variables
children.covers: Identifying independent and dependent variables in real-world relationships.

children.title: Write Equations to Represent Relationships Represented in Tables
children.covers: Writing a two-variable equation from a table of values.

children.title: Graphs of Relationships
children.covers: Graphing two-variable relationships and interpreting the graphs.

children.title: Multiple Representations
children.covers: Connecting words, tables, equations, and graphs that show the same relationship.

toc.label: Module 8
toc.title: Area
toc.covers: Area formulas for parallelograms, triangles, trapezoids, and regular polygons, and polygons on the coordinate plane.

children.title: Area of Parallelograms
children.covers: Deriving and using the parallelogram area formula.

children.title: Area of Triangles
children.covers: Finding triangle area as half of a parallelogram.

children.title: Area of Trapezoids
children.covers: Finding trapezoid area by decomposing into triangles and parallelograms.

children.title: Area of Regular Polygons
children.covers: Finding areas of regular polygons by decomposing them into triangles.

children.title: Polygons on the Coordinate Plane
children.covers: Drawing polygons from vertex coordinates and finding side lengths, perimeter, and area.

toc.label: Module 9
toc.title: Volume and Surface Area
toc.covers: Volume of rectangular prisms with fractional edges and surface area of prisms and pyramids from nets.

children.title: Volume of Rectangular Prisms
children.covers: Finding volume of rectangular prisms, including fractional edge lengths, with V = lwh and V = Bh.

children.title: Surface Area of Rectangular Prisms
children.covers: Using nets to find the surface area of rectangular prisms.

children.title: Surface Area of Triangular Prisms
children.covers: Using nets to find the surface area of triangular prisms.

children.title: Surface Area of Pyramids
children.covers: Using nets to find the surface area of square and triangular pyramids.

toc.label: Module 10
toc.title: Statistical Measures and Displays
toc.covers: Statistical questions, data displays, measures of center and variability, outliers, and describing distributions.

children.title: Statistical Questions
children.covers: Recognizing questions that anticipate variability in the data.

children.title: Dot Plots and Histograms
children.covers: Displaying numerical data in dot plots and histograms.

children.title: Measures of Center
children.covers: Finding and interpreting mean, median, and mode.

children.title: Interquartile Range and Box Plots
children.covers: Finding quartiles and the interquartile range and drawing box plots.

children.title: Mean Absolute Deviation
children.covers: Computing mean absolute deviation to describe spread.

children.title: Outliers
children.covers: Identifying outliers and their effect on measures of center and spread.

children.title: Interpret Graphical Displays
children.covers: Describing a distribution's center, spread, and shape and choosing suitable measures.

notes: Volume 1 holds Modules 1-4; Volume 2 holds Modules 5-10 (the English Tennessee student-edition cover and the Spanish national student-edition cover in the 2020 catalog agree). The work-list ISBNs match the 2020 catalog: Interactive Student Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-667372-8, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899714-3; Teacher Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-899720-4, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899175-2. Lesson titles follow the Pengi listing, which matches the publisher's Oklahoma overview except Module 10. State editions differ: the Oklahoma edition drops lesson 10-4 (Interquartile Range and Box Plots) and adds Modules 11-12 (transformations, congruence and similarity) plus 13 state lessons. Each module also has a pretest, Put It All Together checkpoints, and a module review and assessment; the New Mexico sampler paces Module 2 at 15 days of 45-minute periods. Most lesson descriptions are from general knowledge of the topic, since the sources give titles only.
